review_locator: PMID:17109193, Vascular endothelial growth factor receptor-1 (VEGFR-1/Flt-1): a dual regulator for angiogenesis; PMID:11312109, Structure and dual function of vascular endothelial growth factor receptor-1 (Flt-1)
primary_title: Vascular endothelial growth factor B (VEGF-B) binds to VEGF receptor-1 and regulates plasminogen activator activity in endothelial cells
decision_basis: The reviews identify VEGFR1/FLT1 as a cognate receptor for VEGF-B and cite the primary study for selective receptor binding and endothelial plasminogen-activator regulation.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3504444, Frizzled and LRP5/6 Receptors for Wnt/beta-Catenin Signaling; PMCID:PMC3592934, LRP5 and LRP6 in Development and Disease; PMCID:PMC6982462, Dickkopf1: An immunomodulatory ligand and Wnt antagonist
primary_title: Head inducer Dickkopf-1 is a ligand for Wnt coreceptor LRP6
decision_basis: The reviews identify DKK1 as a high-affinity LRP6 ligand and cite the primary study showing that DKK1 prevents Wnt-induced Frizzled-LRP6 complex formation and antagonizes canonical Wnt signaling.
limitations_preserved: This is an inhibitory ligand-coreceptor edge, not productive Wnt activation; preserve DKK1-LRP6 binding and Frizzled-LRP6 complex disruption, with no SCI or terminal-TF inference.
